purpose: A hardware-first hardware/vendor/service/human capability and escalation inspection wizard for Samsung Android and controlled desktop hosts.

phases.meaning: hardware CPU/architecture, kernel and memory, optionally read-only block-device inventory
OS, firmware and verified-boot vendor facts; preserve Samsung GKI, Knox and Android secure boot
Python, npm, Git, Godot, Blender, optional SQLite/MariaDB/DNSmasq/NGINX as capability data only
explain smallest local-first next step and optional authenticated remote escalation; no privileged mutation

gparted.caution: partition creation/movement may erase data; backup and owner approval required

rufus.caution: USB formatting is destructive; never infer selected target

androidBoot.caution: No Android bootloader changes inferred or performed

approvalBoundary: Professor must explicitly authorize actual disk, firmware, boot-media or privileged changes in a separate tool with validated physical context
